allow us to answer your questions

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_divider color=”#860107″ divider_weight=”4px” _builder_version=”4.16″ width=”20%” module_alignment=”center” custom_margin=”||20px||false|false” global_colors_info=”{}”][/et_pb_divider][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure=”1_2,1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” min_height=”358px” custom_padding=”0px||||false|false” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_image src=”https://noriegascustomcabinets.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/2971AD23-096C-4DE4-B5DE-DE18B4B1EF25_1_105_c.jpeg” title_text=”2971AD23-096C-4DE4-B5DE-DE18B4B1EF25_1_105_c” disabled_on=”on|on|off” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” width=”100%” border_width_bottom=”5px” border_color_bottom=”#860107″ global_colors_info=”{}”][/et_pb_image][et_pb_accordion open_toggle_text_color=”#0E315B” open_toggle_background_color=”#F5F5F5″ closed_toggle_background_color=”#0E315B” disabled_on=”on|on|off” _builder_version=”4.20.2″ _module_preset=”default” toggle_text_color=”#FFFFFF” toggle_font=”|800|||||||” toggle_font_size=”18px” body_text_color=”#0E315B” body_font_size=”16px” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_accordion_item title=”Are my cabinets able to support the weight of new countertops & do they have to be level?” open=”on” _builder_version=”4.20.2″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”]

The majority of cabinets can easily handle the weight of new counters. Cabinets must be within an 1/8″ level before we can install your countertops. Even if your current countertops are level there is a possibilty that the cabinets underneath are not. We will not be able to asses the shape of existing cabinets until a tear out is performed. If it is deemed that the cabinets are not able to support the additional weight or are not level it is the customer’s responsibility to have that corrected.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title=”Can my new granite countertops chip?” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}” open=”off”]

Granite has a natural rigidity and durability that makes chipping nearly impossible unless there are unusual circumstances such as the impact of a hammer. In the event of an accident, a chip can be filled with a granite dust and epoxy mixture. If you save the pieces we can also use them to fix your countertop.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title=”Do I have to have all my appliances on site at template?” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}” open=”off”]

We require all sinks to be on site at template and all model numbers to be provided for all other appliances. We will also need to know how many faucet holes you would like to have drilled at that time. All appliances need to be on site the day of installation.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][/et_pb_accordion][et_pb_accordion open_toggle_text_color=”#0E315B” open_toggle_background_color=”#F5F5F5″ closed_toggle_background_color=”#0E315B” disabled_on=”off|off|on” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” toggle_text_color=”#FFFFFF” toggle_font=”|800|||||||” toggle_font_size=”18px” body_text_color=”#0E315B” body_font_size=”16px” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_accordion_item title=”Are my cabinets able to support the weight of new countertops & do they have to be level?” open=”on” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”]

The majority of cabinets can easily handle the weight of new counters. Cabinets must be within an 1/8″ level before we can install your countertops. Even if your current countertops are level there is a possibilty that the cabinets underneath are not. We will not be able to asses the shape of existing cabinets until a tear out is performed. If it is deemed that the cabinets are not able to support the additional weight or are not level it is the customers responsibility to have that corrected.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title=”Can my new granite countertops chip?” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}” open=”off”]

Granite has a natural rigidity and durability that makes chipping nearly impossible unless there are unusual circumstances such as the impact of a hammer. In the event of an accident, a chip can be filled with a granite dust and epoxy mixture. If you save the pieces we can also use them to fix your countertop.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title=”Do I have to have all my appliances on site at template?” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}” open=”off”]

We require all sinks to be on site at template and all model numbers to be provided for all other appliances. We will also need to know how many faucet holes you would like to have drilled at that time. All appliances need to be on site the day of installation.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title=”CAN I CUT ON MY STONE COUNTERTOPS?” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}” open=”off”]

Only if you want to ruin your good knives. Most stone, like granite, is harder than your knife blades and will dull them very quickly. We recommend that you always cut and chop on a wooden or plastic cutting board. You can cut on granite countertops without ruining your counterops. 

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title=”WHAT KIND OF PAYMENTS DO YOU TAKE?” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}” open=”off”]

Noriega’s accepts checks, cash, and all major credit cards.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title=”WHERE DO YOU INSTALL CABINETS AND GRANITE COUNTERS?” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}” open=”off”]

We work in Mt Pleasant, Texarkana, & Pittsburg, TX, and the surrounding areas. 

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title=”DO I HAVE TO BUY THE WHOLE SHEET/SLAB?” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}” open=”off”]

We do not charge you the price of full slabs. You pay for the square footage that is required to fabricate your tops. However, there is a required minimum on some materials.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title=”HOW QUICKLY CAN I HAVE MY TOPS INSTALLED?” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}” open=”off”]

Installation times can vary depending on material availability and production times. Please contact us to you to find out our current lead times.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][/et_pb_accordion][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_accordion open_toggle_text_color=”#0E315B” open_toggle_background_color=”#F5F5F5″ closed_toggle_background_color=”#0E315B” disabled_on=”on|on|off” _builder_version=”4.20.2″ _module_preset=”default” toggle_text_color=”#FFFFFF” toggle_font=”|800|||||||” toggle_font_size=”18px” body_text_color=”#0E315B” body_font_size=”16px” hover_enabled=”0″ global_colors_info=”{}” sticky_enabled=”0″][et_pb_accordion_item title=”Can I cut on my stone countertops?” open=”off” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Only if you want to ruin your good knives. Most stone, like granite, is harder than your knife blades and will dull them very quickly. We recommend that you always cut and chop on a wooden or plastic cutting board. You can cut on granite countertops without ruining your counterops. 

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title=”What kind of payments do you take?” _builder_version=”4.20.2″ _module_preset=”default” hover_enabled=”0″ global_colors_info=”{}” open=”on” sticky_enabled=”0″]

We’re happy to accept cash, checks, and all major credit cards.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title=”Where do you install cabinets and granite counters?” _builder_version=”4.20.2″ _module_preset=”default” hover_enabled=”0″ global_colors_info=”{}” open=”off” sticky_enabled=”0″]

We provide services throughout Mt. Pleasant, Texarkana, Pittsburg, TX, and nearby areas.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title=”Do I have to buy the whole sheet/slab?” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}” open=”off”]

We do not charge you the price of full slabs. You pay for the square footage that is required to fabricate your tops. However, there is a required minimum on some materials.

 

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title=”How quickly can I have my tops installed?” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}” open=”off”]

Installation times can vary depending on material availability and production times. Please contact us to you to find out our current lead times.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][/et_pb_accordion][et_pb_image src=”https://noriegascustomcabinets.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/D7CE74DA-84B5-41AA-919E-A186F9BED7C4.jpeg” title_text=”D7CE74DA-84B5-41AA-919E-A186F9BED7C4″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” width=”100%” border_width_bottom=”5px” border_color_bottom=”#860107″ global_colors_info=”{}”][/et_pb_image][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]
